title: Raman G-band peak shift across annealing temperatures
what: 600 C G-band blueshift (cm^-1) relative to as-deposited, or 600 C peak position

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: The 600 C anneal blueshifts the G-band by +16 cm^-1 (from 1578 to 1594 cm^-1).

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; the +16 cm^-1 shift is four spectral steps wide and well above the low baseline noise.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: The 350 C anneal shifts the G-band only slightly (+8 cm^-1), while the D-band near 1352 cm^-1 shrinks noticeably at 600 C.
